purpose: Catalog of complex C/C-major projects for staged C-to-Rust migration validation.

targets.name: SQLite
targets.migration_slice: CRC/hash helpers or a small VFS-independent utility module before pager/btree migration.
targets.oracle_strategy: SQL input/output golden transcripts and native sqlite3 CLI result comparison.
targets.performance_smoke: Run a fixed INSERT/SELECT transaction script and record elapsed time.
targets.risk_notes: Generated parser and storage invariants make broad migration high risk.

targets.name: Redis
targets.migration_slice: RESP parser helper or SDS string utility slice.
targets.oracle_strategy: RESP request/response transcript comparison against native Redis helper.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed in-process parser throughput or redis-benchmark subset after L3 exists.
targets.risk_notes: Server lifecycle, forks, networking, and persistence should be deferred until small slices pass.

targets.name: nginx
targets.migration_slice: URI/HTTP header parsing helper with fixed input corpus.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native helper or extracted parser golden JSON for request-line/header cases.
targets.risk_notes: Runtime module ABI and event loop should not be migrated before parser/helper slices.

targets.name: curl
targets.migration_slice: URL parser or percent-encoding helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: URL parse fixtures compared with native curl/libcurl output.
targets.risk_notes: Protocol matrix and TLS backends require strict feature scoping.

targets.name: Git
targets.migration_slice: hash/hex/pathspec helper or pkt-line parser slice.
targets.oracle_strategy: Golden object/hash/path fixtures against native git plumbing.
targets.risk_notes: Repository state and platform-specific behavior need pinned fixtures.

targets.name: OpenSSL
targets.migration_slice: Non-secret encoding/ASN.1 helper only; avoid cryptographic primitive rewrites at first.
targets.oracle_strategy: Known-answer encoding vectors and native openssl CLI comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Security-sensitive code requires stronger review and constant-time analysis before L3 claims.

targets.name: FFmpeg
targets.migration_slice: Small bitstream reader or container metadata parser helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Golden bitstream fixtures and ffprobe/ffmpeg JSON output comparison.
targets.risk_notes: SIMD, codec correctness, and undefined behavior need per-slice handling.

targets.name: PostgreSQL
targets.migration_slice: StringInfo, checksum, or small frontend utility helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Golden utility output and native frontend command comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Backend/server semantics and WAL require staged oracle design.

targets.name: Lua
targets.migration_slice: Lexer token helper or string table utility with fixed scripts.
targets.oracle_strategy: Lua script output fixtures and native lua CLI comparison.
targets.risk_notes: GC and VM stack invariants should be deferred until helper slices pass.

targets.name: libuv
targets.migration_slice: Path/string/platform-independent helper slice.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native helper output or unit-test fixture comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Callback lifetimes and cross-platform behavior require strict ownership modeling.

targets.name: libevent
targets.migration_slice: evbuffer helper or URI parser subset.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native test fixture output and schema-aware buffer operation reports.
targets.risk_notes: Event loop and backend differences need isolated platform matrix.

targets.name: zlib-ng
targets.migration_slice: Adler32/CRC helper before compressor state machine.
targets.oracle_strategy: Known-answer checksum vectors and native test output.
targets.risk_notes: SIMD and compression state machines need later deeper gates.

targets.name: libpng
targets.migration_slice: Chunk CRC/type parsing or filter helper with small PNG fixtures.
targets.oracle_strategy: Golden PNG chunk metadata and native pngtest comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Image decoding correctness and zlib interactions need pinned fixtures.

targets.name: Mbed TLS
targets.migration_slice: Non-secret base64 or PEM parsing helper before cryptographic primitives.
targets.oracle_strategy: Known-answer non-secret encoding fixtures and native test-suite comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Secret-dependent code requires security review before migration claims.

targets.name: jemalloc
targets.migration_slice: Size-class helper or bitmap utility only.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native unit fixture output and deterministic helper vectors.
targets.risk_notes: Allocator correctness and concurrency need extensive L3 before runtime use.

targets.name: Valkey
targets.migration_slice: RESP parser or SDS string utility slice before server lifecycle work.
targets.oracle_strategy: RESP request/response transcripts compared against native Valkey parser/helper.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed RESP parser corpus or command table lookup timing.
targets.risk_notes: Cluster, forked persistence, and module ABI require separate deep gates.

targets.name: Zstandard
targets.migration_slice: Checksum, frame header, or small bitstream reader helper before compressor/decompressor state machines.
targets.oracle_strategy: Known-answer frame/header vectors and native zstd CLI comparison.
targets.risk_notes: Bit-level compatibility and optimized backends require strict fixture coverage.

targets.name: libjpeg-turbo
targets.migration_slice: Scalar Huffman table or marker parsing helper before DCT/SIMD paths.
targets.oracle_strategy: Small JPEG marker/metadata fixtures and native test output comparison.
targets.risk_notes: SIMD and codec correctness should be gated after scalar helper equivalence.

targets.name: MicroPython
targets.migration_slice: qstr/hash helper, lexer token helper, or small runtime utility under `py/`.
targets.oracle_strategy: Python script output fixtures compared with native unix-port MicroPython.
targets.risk_notes: GC, VM stack, generated qstrs, and per-port configs require careful pinning.

targets.name: tmux
targets.migration_slice: UTF-8/grid helper or command parser subset with fixed input lines.
targets.oracle_strategy: Command parse or terminal-grid fixtures compared with native helper output.
targets.risk_notes: Terminal behavior and PTY lifecycle require isolated integration gates.

targets.name: Zephyr
targets.migration_slice: Small kernel utility, ring buffer helper, or subsystem parser that can be built for qemu_x86.
targets.oracle_strategy: QEMU sample logs or native ztest output compared with Rust helper output.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed helper corpus or QEMU smoke duration.
targets.risk_notes: Multi-repo west workspace and generated config make broad migration expensive.

targets.name: FreeRTOS-Kernel
targets.migration_slice: List, queue helper, or portable-independent utility before scheduler semantics.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native unit/vector helper output and scheduler-free fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Scheduler timing and interrupt semantics require separate RTOS-aware gates.

targets.name: Linux Kernel
targets.migration_slice: User-space tools helper, lib/ checksum/string helper, or a single selftest-owned utility before kernel runtime paths.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native kselftest output or small C helper vectors from tools/lib and lib helpers.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed helper corpus timing or kselftest elapsed time.
targets.risk_notes: Kernel config, inline assembly, RCU, atomics, interrupts, and hardware assumptions make broad migration unsafe without tiny slices.

targets.name: QEMU
targets.migration_slice: qemu-img helper, block format probe, util data structure, or small wire-format parser.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native qemu-img/qemu-system smoke output plus C helper JSON for selected util/block fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Generated code, coroutine scheduling, device models, and host feature dependencies require narrow scoping.

targets.name: systemd
targets.migration_slice: src/basic utility, journal field parser, udev rule parser subset, or bus message helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native unit/helper output and fixed parser fixtures with normalized environment fields.
targets.risk_notes: Many tests require privileges, cgroups, namespaces, or specific Linux host state.

targets.name: Vim
targets.migration_slice: regexp helper, option parser, buffer line utility, or ex command parser subset.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native vim command transcript and C helper fixtures for parser/helper functions.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed regex or command parser corpus timing.
targets.risk_notes: Editor state, terminal behavior, locale, and script compatibility make full migration broad.

targets.name: HAProxy
targets.migration_slice: HTTP header parser, ACL sample converter, ring buffer helper, or stick-table key helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native parser/helper JSON or CLI config validation output for fixed fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Hot paths, intrusive lists, TLS/QUIC options, and vtest-dependent regressions require scoped gates.

targets.name: libxml2
targets.migration_slice: Tokenizer/SAX state subset, entity parser, URI helper, or XPath token helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native xmllint output and C helper JSON for fixed XML fixtures including negative cases.
targets.risk_notes: Security-sensitive XML behaviors and legacy compatibility need exact error-code and entity handling policy.

targets.name: wolfSSL
targets.migration_slice: Non-secret base64/ASN.1/PEM helper or X.509 field parser before cryptographic primitives.
targets.oracle_strategy: Known-answer non-secret encoding fixtures and native testwolfcrypt/testsuite output.
targets.risk_notes: Secret-dependent code and constant-time properties require security-specific review before migration claims.

targets.name: libpcap
targets.migration_slice: BPF lexer/parser subset, pcap file header parser, or filter optimizer helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native tcpdump/libpcap filter compile output and pcap fixture metadata JSON.
targets.performance_smoke: Fixed BPF filter corpus compile timing.
targets.risk_notes: Kernel capture backends and platform-specific device behavior should be avoided in early slices.

targets.name: tcpdump
targets.migration_slice: Single protocol printer, address formatter, or packet header parser helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native tcpdump text output for fixed pcap fixtures and schema-normalized packet fields.
targets.risk_notes: Output formatting, protocol edge cases, and libpcap dependency versions must be pinned.

targets.name: memcached
targets.migration_slice: ASCII protocol parser, item metadata helper, hash helper, or slab class computation.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native protocol transcript fixtures and C helper JSON for parser/slab cases.
targets.risk_notes: Networking, threads, slab concurrency, and extstore behavior are later gates.

targets.name: libgit2
targets.migration_slice: OID parser, pkt-line helper, pathspec helper, or pack index metadata parser.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native libgit2 test fixtures and C helper JSON for object/path/pkt-line cases.
targets.risk_notes: Filesystem and repository state semantics need pinned fixture repositories.

targets.name: librdkafka
targets.migration_slice: Kafka protocol encoder/decoder subset, topic partition helper, or config parser.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native protocol fixture encoder output and schema-aware diff for request/response fields.
targets.risk_notes: Cluster integration, network timing, compression, and C++ wrappers should be outside first slices.

targets.name: x264
targets.migration_slice: NAL header parser, bitstream writer helper, CABAC/CAVLC table helper, or scalar pixel utility.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native x264 bitstream metadata and C helper vectors with asm disabled.
targets.risk_notes: Codec bit-exactness, SIMD, rate control, and floating-point paths require strict fixtures.

targets.name: OpenVPN
targets.migration_slice: Option parser, packet framing helper, route parser, or non-secret base64/key-value helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native CLI/config parse output and C helper JSON for packet/config fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Privilege, network devices, platform routing, and crypto/session lifecycle are later gates.

targets.name: ImageMagick
targets.migration_slice: MagickCore geometry parser, color parser, pixel math helper, or a dependency-light coder metadata parser.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native magick identify/convert output and C helper JSON for geometry/color fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Delegate formats, policy files, OpenMP, and floating-point pixel differences need tight normalization.

targets.name: MuPDF
targets.migration_slice: PDF object parser, xref helper, stream filter wrapper, or path flattening helper.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native mutool output and C helper JSON for PDF object/xref fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: PDF edge cases, vendored thirdparty code, rendering nondeterminism, and licensing require isolation.

targets.name: HDF5
targets.migration_slice: Dataspace selection helper, chunk cache helper, filter pipeline metadata helper, or B-tree utility.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native h5dump/h5diff output and C helper JSON for generated HDF5 fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Test runtime, file-format compatibility, optional language bindings, and filters need strict scope.

targets.name: OpenSSH Portable
targets.migration_slice: sshbuf helper, known_hosts parser, authfile parser, packet framing, or key option parser.
targets.oracle_strategy: Native unit/regress output and C helper JSON for non-secret parser/buffer fixtures.
targets.risk_notes: Security boundary, OpenSSL/LibreSSL differences, sandboxing, PAM, and platform ifdefs require careful isolation.
